title: History of taxation in the United Kingdom
displaytitle: History of taxation in the United Kingdom

titles.normalized: History of taxation in the United Kingdom
titles.display: History of taxation in the United Kingdom

extract: The history of taxation in the United Kingdom includes the history of all collections by governments under law, in money or in kind, including collections by monarchs and lesser feudal lords, levied on persons or property subject to the government, with the primary purpose of raising revenue.
